topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Masters above, the talk in the village square has turned to dark matters. A young scholar, they say, has sullied the pages of his work with another's words, claiming them as his own. The whisper is that his deceit be as clear as the noon sun on a cloudless day. The bailiff speaks of harsh judgment, and the tides of fate seem to turn against him. The soil does not lie, nor does the sweat on a man's brow, and I cannot help but wonder what judgment awaits those who cheat the sky. May the saints guide his path, for the earth is not kind to those who stray from the true seed.
